Thanks,

Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff — tracer details and alert routing notes

Hi all — quick technical note to save time on the call. High-level checklist for tracing and alerting we want to validate during kickoff:
- Tracing anchors: identify 3 top-level entry points (api.gateway, ingestion.worker, embed.pipeline)
- Required span attributes: request_id, customer_id, model_variant, batch_id, latency_ms
- Sampling: low-sampling for background jobs (0.01), 100% for error traces in production for 1 minute windows
- KV cache visibility: ensure LRU hit/miss metrics exposed per shard
- Alerts: baseline using 7d median + 2x deviation for latency spikes; critical alerts route to PagerDuty (triage-pd), warning alerts to Slack #triage-observability

Attached a CSV with suggested tracing hook names and a short guidance doc on cache/kv metrics. I can take ownership of the tracing instrumentation checklist and run a follow-up code review with your engineering team.

Ben
Ben Carter
SRE Solutions, Redwood Inference
